summary: Detection-only change: no new subprocess, no shell, no network, no writes from any new code path (alignment_gaps and has_discovery_material are pure reads; the only mutation surface, project mark-predates, is untouched). Gap details embed repo-relative paths and fixed command strings only - no user-controlled content is interpolated into anything executable. The honesty boundary holds: nothing auto-creates specs, epics, or roadmap entries anywhere in the diff.
residual_risks: Gap messages reflect ledger/roadmap content lengths only; a hostile ledger.json could at most inflate audit output, not execute anything.
